summary: Apollo Commercial Real Estate Finance filed an 8-K announcing an Amended and Restated Management Agreement with its manager. The fee structure now ties the base management fee (initially 0.75% or 1.5% of equity per annum) to quarterly ROE thresholds, payable in stock (or cash under conditions). This change reflects a material shift in management compensation incentives, effectively a governance event. No deal terms apply. Watch for future ROE milestone achievements affecting fee payments and potential alignment of manager-shareholder interests.
